title: Route Handlers (API)
description: Next.js ichida Backend API larni yozish (route.ts)

blocks.text: Next.js faqat frontend framework emas, u orqali to'laqonli Backend API lar ham yozish mumkin (baza bilan ulanib).
API yo'llarini yaratish xuddi sahifa yaratishga o'xshaydi, lekin `page.tsx` o'rniga **`route.ts`** faylini yaratamiz. API lar odatda adashib ketmaslik uchun `app/api/...` papkasi ichida qilinadi.

blocks.text: Xuddi sahifalar singari, API larda ham papka nomini `[id]` qilish orqali dinamik URL o'qiladi.

examples.title: 2. Dinamik API yozish
[id] route handler — params ikkinchi argumentda
RouteContext — avtomatik tip
Topilmasa 404
ID raqam emas — 400
To'liq CRUD — /api/todos va /api/todos/[id]
PUT — to'liq almashtirish
Ichma-ich resurs — /api/users/[id]/orders
Ikki dinamik segment — /api/shops/[shop]/items/[item]
Catch-all — /api/files/[...path]
Optional catch-all — /api/docs/[[...slug]]
generateStaticParams route handler uchun
